repairs.before: search-federator canary build 2026.9.3 has been running on 4 of 240 production hosts since Sep 8. Owner Dan Ortiz. p99 response time on canary hosts is 311 ms against 184 ms on the control fleet, an increase of 127 ms or 69%; p50 is essentially unchanged at 41 ms to 42 ms. The service SLO is p99 under 250 ms. Cause traced to a new gRPC interceptor that validates response payloads against a JSON schema synchronously on the serving path. The schema cache is a 512-entry LRU; at the canary's 2,900 QPS per host the working set is roughly 3,400 distinct schemas, so the cache thrashes, with a 71% hit rate against 99.6% in the pre-release load test, which exercised only 300 schemas. Median cost of the interceptor is 0.9 ms; p99 cost is 94 ms, dominated by schema recompilation. No member impact: canary carries 1.7% of traffic and zero error budget was consumed. Decision taken Sep 15: revert the interceptor from the release branch, raise the cache to 8,192 entries, move validation behind a 1% sampling flag, re-canary Sep 22. Write the status update for the weekly engineering review and the service's SLO owners.
